## SmartBeam 1.1.0

- Fixes a startup issue where the beam indication could incorrectly show green before the beam has been established

## SmartBeam beta 1.2.2

- During an OTA update, the two system LEDs alternate a dim purple indication every 600 ms, matching SmartBroom's firmware-transfer cue. The beam and battery LEDs keep their normal indications.

## SmartBeam beta 1.2.106

### Fixes

- Keep lifetime-log NVS operations outside FreeRTOS critical sections.
- Count battery runtime correctly when USB connection state changes without an SOC or charging-state change.

# SmartBeam 1.3.169 Beta

- Improves upgrade reliability from 1.2: a newly installed update starts active on USB so its services can qualify it before cancelling rollback.
- Preserves device identity and lifetime counters when saved data cannot be read. Settings changes and device-info reset finish before reporting completion.
- Preserves beam transitions when processing is delayed, and recovers from an overflowing event queue without reporting a false duration or duplicate event.
- Fixes fragmented Bluetooth writes that could silently truncate a device name. Fragmented serial-number and OTA writes are decoded as complete values.
- Includes the 1.3 charging-only USB startup, responsive shutdown and button wake, recovery supervision, and improved battery-estimate behavior. Startup feedback appears promptly after the power latch is asserted.

Validation: all 13 automated host/configuration test groups passed, including shipping-1.2 upgrade/rollback readers, interrupted installations, persistence failures and concurrency. The new upgrade, persistence-workflow and GATT suites also passed AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer checks. Target firmware build passed.

Physical sealed-device upgrade, power-cut and rollback qualification has not been performed for this build. App-only OTA does not replace the installed second-stage bootloader.

Signed beta OTA package for the beta stream. Earlier releases remain immutable.

# SmartBeam 1.3.191 Beta

- Preserves the current battery percentage when constant-voltage (CV) charging begins, so the estimate no longer falls toward 80%.
- Prorates the remaining CV charging time from the starting percentage: 90% leaves 22.5 minutes and 95% leaves 11.25 minutes under the existing model.
- Retains display smoothing, short-interruption handling, and confirmed charge completion before advancing to 100%.

Validation: all 12 SmartBeam automated host regression groups passed, including CV entry below 80%, at 90%, at 95%, at 100%, and CV session restart. Target firmware build passed. Physical charging qualification has not been performed for this build.

Signed beta OTA package for the beta stream. Earlier releases remain immutable.

# SmartBeam 1.4.23 beta

- Improves button debounce and release timing.
- Adds internal stuck-button diagnostics; existing emergency reset behavior is retained.

# SmartBeam 1.4.43 beta

- Standard beta/development profile with Bluetooth modem sleep enabled (mode 1, main crystal clock).
- Includes the all-product configuration check requiring production and development Bluetooth sleep settings to match.

Host validation and ESP-IDF firmware build passed. Battery-current measurements and physical device qualification remain pending.
